The diagram shows an equilateral triangle RST and also the triangle $T U V$ obtained by rotating triangle $R S T$ about the point $T$. Angle $R T V=70^{\circ}$. What is angle $R S V$?

A:$20^{\circ}$
B:$25^{\circ}$
C:$30^{\circ}$
D:$35^{\circ}$
E:$40^{\circ}$

    $$2 \times \angle TSV + \angle STV = 180^{\circ}$$
    $$2 \times \angle TSV + 10^{\circ} = 180^{\circ}$$

    $$\angle RSV = \angle TSV - \angle TSR$$
